judgement.reason: Superset runs as one web image with Celery workers on PostgreSQL and Redis; the websocket and node services are optional or dev-only, so the outcome stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (superset, superset-websocket, superset-node). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The docker-compose.yml that lists these services is a development stack (DEV_MODE true, dev build target, source bind mounts) that the project states is not for production; the production Dockerfile builds the frontend into one image served by one web process.

evidence.quote: # We don't support docker compose for production environments.
